about.title: One Houston technician, 21 years in the trade, on every job.
text: Ace Comfort Air Conditioning & Heating has been serving the Greater Houston Area since 2015. Abram Ayala founded the company after working his way up from helper to licensed HVAC technician, building a reputation for honest pricing and quality residential HVAC services.

Abram did not start at the top. He started as a helper, learned the trade from the ground up, and earned his state HVAC license after more than two decades of hands-on experience. He founded Ace Comfort because he believed homeowners deserved a contractor who was honest, skilled and genuinely invested in the outcome, and he remains hands-on with every job.

Since opening, the company has completed hundreds of residential AC repairs and system installations across Houston and surrounding communities. As it grew, it added high-efficiency system upgrades and indoor air quality solutions, and built partnerships with brands like Trane and American Standard. None of that growth came from advertising. It came from referrals and repeat customers who know what to expect: a technician who shows up on time, tells the truth and gets the job done right.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency HVAC services?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer emergency HVAC services for urgent issues outside regular business hours, 365 days a year. Call (281) 658-5141 for immediate assistance.

faqs.q: How often should I schedule HVAC maintenance?
faqs.a: At least once a year, ideally before the start of the heating and cooling seasons. Regular maintenance helps prevent breakdowns, improve efficiency and prolong the life of your system.

faqs.q: How often should I replace my HVAC air filter?
faqs.a: Every 1 to 3 months, depending on the type of filter, whether you have pets, and your indoor air quality. Regular filter changes keep performance and air quality where they should be.

faqs.q: Why is my AC unit freezing up?
faqs.a: Several things can cause it, including low refrigerant levels, poor airflow or a failing blower motor. It is worth addressing promptly to prevent further damage to the system.

faqs.q: What is the lifespan of an HVAC system?
faqs.a: It varies by brand, maintenance and usage. On average, a well-maintained system lasts 15 to 20 years, and regular maintenance extends it.

faqs.q: When should I consider replacing my AC system?
faqs.a: Replacement is often the right call if your system is more than 10 to 15 years old, breaking down often, or no longer cooling efficiently. Energy bills that keep rising despite repairs are another sign.

faqs.q: How much does AC replacement cost in Houston?
faqs.a: Most homeowners spend $4,500 to $8,000 for an AC replacement, depending on the system size and efficiency. Most installations are finished in a single day, including removal and testing.
Yes. We offer flexible financing, as low as 0%, with a quick online application and a decision in minutes, no hidden fees and no prepayment penalties.

faqs.q: Do you offer warranties on installations?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer warranties and guarantees on our air conditioning installations, with full labor warranties and manufacturer protection on replacements.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle repair, installation and maintenance for both residential and commercial properties, and we work around your schedule to minimize downtime.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra for emergency service?
faqs.a: No. There are no extra fees for an emergency call. You get the same honest rates day or night, with transparent pricing and no hidden costs.

faqs.q: What counts as an emergency AC repair?
faqs.a: Any situation where your cooling has failed completely, poses a safety risk or leaves the house unbearable: a total breakdown, a refrigerant leak, an electrical failure, or losing cooling in extreme heat.

faqs.q: How quickly can you get here?
faqs.a: We offer same-day service on most repair calls and aim to arrive within hours, not days. Emergency calls are prioritized.

faqs.q: How much does heating repair cost in Houston?
faqs.a: It depends on the issue, the parts and the system. A simple fix such as a thermostat replacement starts around $150, while a compressor or heat exchanger repair runs higher. You get upfront pricing before any work starts.

faqs.q: How much does furnace installation cost in Houston?
faqs.a: Most furnace installations fall between $3,500 and $7,500, depending on system size, efficiency rating and the layout of your home. Most are finished in four to six hours.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my furnace?
faqs.a: Repair usually makes sense on a unit under 10 years old that has had yearly maintenance and a minor fault. Replacement is the better choice past 12 to 15 years, when repairs cost more than 30 percent of a new system, or when heating is uneven and bills keep climbing.

faqs.q: What brands of heating and cooling systems do you work on?
faqs.a: All major brands, including Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Rheem, Bryant, Goodman, American Standard, Westinghouse, Honeywell and York.

faqs.q: Can I do furnace maintenance myself?
faqs.a: You can change filters yourself. A full tune-up needs a trained technician, because a DIY check misses the heat exchanger, gas valve, ignition and carbon monoxide safety items that matter most.
